title: Kit blocks: the larger 2D blocks on an everyday subject

scenes.heading: Orders
scenes.say: Monday, the cafe orders twenty loaves. Tuesday, the school wants forty rolls. A wedding cake comes in by phone. The recipe: flour, then starter, and a new step, fold twice.

scenes.heading: The morning
scenes.say: At four, the baker shapes the dough. The trays go to the shop. A customer asks for rye, and the shop hands it over. The rule holds.

scenes.heading: Sales
scenes.say: By Saturday, sourdough sells best, and brioche is sold out. The till prints three hundred and twelve loaves. Rye never led.
